hook: Hackers took over Telangana's *TG-iPASS* industry portal. Back in *2 days*, govt says
tldr: Telangana's TG-iPASS portal, which handles industrial approvals, was taken over in a cyber attack. The Industries Department says it has regained control, data on the server is safe, and the site will reopen within two days with stronger firewalls.

beats.what: Director of Industries Nikhil Chakravarthy said the portal was recovered from cyber criminals and is being hardened before reopening.
beats.why: No details yet on how attackers got in.
beats.care: Startups and businesses waiting on approvals face a delay. It's also a reminder: PM Modi said the same day that cyberattacks on the economy can weaken a country.

cards.why: It's Telangana's single-window system for clearances to set up industries.

viz.l: until TG-iPASS reopens, per the govt

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: TG-iPASS portal to be restored in two days (print, Hyderabad edition, 26 Oct, p.6)
